entities.summary: Leonardo Leyva Martínez is a Cuban male volleyball player. He was part of the Cuba men's national volleyball team. He has played professionally in Cuba, Puerto Rico, Russia, Qatar, South Korea, Turkey, China and the United Arab Emirates.
